invariants.rationale: The method always initializes partitionSmallFilesMap before returning, so result is never null.
partitionSmallFilesMap is a HashMap and the method only returns this variable, so result is always a Map.
If partitionPaths is null or empty, result is empty; otherwise, result has one entry per partitionPath.
Result is not empty only when there are partitionPaths and small file limit is positive.
The values in the result map are never null because they are always set via getSmallFiles.
